title: Prospective Ecology-Calibrated Activation Transport, Frozen Source-Shift & Engine-Conditional Regime Decomposition, Support-Preserving Domain-Shift Falsification, Cross-Ecology Calibration Transfer, Q0 Re-entry Reauthorization & Authority-Safe Mechanism Routing Experiment
scientific_question: Can a prospectively frozen, low-dimensional engine/ecology calibration layer restore activation transport across executable-support-qualified worlds and then transfer to new source identities, without source memorization, support relaxation, or post-outcome rescue?

estimand.endpoint: A_f(e,x)=1 iff FULL_CLASS_f support differs from BASE support under the frozen TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM protocol
estimand.primary: Prospective transfer performance of a calibration layer frozen on a calibration cohort and evaluated on a separately sealed transfer cohort.
estimand.authority_boundary: P24 does not estimate population-wide chess activation outside R=1.

anti_memorization.rule: Every calibration predictor must be computable before FULL_CLASS outcomes and must have a semantic definition that can be applied unchanged to a new source identity.

cohort_design.calibration_cohort: One fresh, presealed source per ecology cell. Outcomes may open only after both cohorts' source identities, acquisition rules and support quotas are frozen.
cohort_design.transfer_cohort: A disjoint fresh source identity per ecology cell. FULL_CLASS outcomes remain unopened until the calibration model, coefficients and classification threshold are sealed.

executable_support.reuse: P23 outcome-blind executable-support acquisition machinery and router grammar without changing chain semantics.
executable_support.firewall: Support selection is completed separately in calibration and transfer cohorts before any FULL_CLASS outcome for that cohort is consulted.

calibration_family.base_object: P22 R1_BOUNDARY_PLUS_LOAD remains the parent activation signal; P24 calibrates its transport rather than rewriting P23.
calibration_family.model: Penalized logistic recalibration; no source-identity coefficient and no source-specific intercept.
calibration_family.penalty: L2 only on non-intercept calibration coefficients; penalty grid frozen before calibration outcomes.
calibration_family.selection: Calibration-cohort leave-one-source-out log loss primary, balanced accuracy secondary. First identify all candidate+penalty pairs within 0.01 mean held-out log loss of the global best; choose the lowest-complexity candidate represented in that set. Within that chosen candidate choose the penalty with the lowest mean held-out log loss, breaking exact ties toward the larger penalty. Then choose the threshold from the frozen grid maximizing held-out balanced accuracy, breaking ties toward the higher threshold. Freeze candidate, penalty, coefficients and threshold before transfer outcomes.
forbidden: family-specific rescue of the primary verdict

frozen_endpoints.log_loss: Must improve over uncalibrated R1 on the transfer cohort.
frozen_endpoints.brier: Must improve over uncalibrated R1 on the transfer cohort.
frozen_endpoints.source_robustness: BA >= 0.60 in at least two transfer sources with both classes.

verdicts.PASS: Calibration and discrimination gates pass prospectively on the locked transfer cohort.
verdicts.PARTIAL_PASS: Calibration improves but discrimination or cross-source robustness misses a frozen gate.
verdicts.FAIL: Adequate support/positive outcomes exist but calibration fails to improve or pooled discrimination fails materially.
verdicts.HOLD: A cohort fails support quotas or the transfer cohort has no positive activation.

q0_reentry.condition: Only after P24 primary PASS may Q0 re-enter, and only for transfer-cohort cells classified ACTIVE by the sealed calibration layer with executable support.

track_b.semantics: Product routing may preserve or reduce causal-language authority based on P24 calibration scope but cannot create scientific authority.
track_b.pass_requirement: A future P24 PASS receipt is required before any calibrated activation route can become SUPPORTED.

manuscript.central_claim_candidate: Executable support and activation transport are distinct; after support is prospectively guaranteed, a low-dimensional ecology/engine calibration layer can be tested for genuine cross-source transfer under a source-memorization firewall.
manuscript.negative_result_value: If P24 fails, the paper identifies regime instability that persists even after support control and explicit prospective calibration.
manuscript.contribution_boundary: No claim of inventing transportability, domain adaptation, calibration, or mechanistic interpretability causal identification.

preoutcome_reconciliations.issue: Penalty tie-break was implicit in the initial P24 preseal.
preoutcome_reconciliations.resolution: Within the selected minimum-complexity candidate, choose the penalty with minimum held-out log loss; exact tie -> larger penalty.
preoutcome_reconciliations.timing: Before any P24 calibration- or transfer-cohort FULL_CLASS outcome is opened.
